name: Kamizono Kyouga
source:
Shinto priest at the Kamizono shrine that the protagonist works at.
He's a fast thinker who is good at picking up the essentials, he has great self-confidence.
He has a bad habit of loving to tease people about their weaknesses.
But because of his good appearance and charismatic personality people strangely don't think of him as unpleasant.
His flower is the Forget-Me-Not.
